scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic; exact rational signs, high-precision numerical bisection and randomized reproducibility checks supplement but do not replace it. No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic one-state annual map, exponent 2, precisely two fixed nonnegative loads, terminal-phosphorus objective. Sediment-memory, stochastic forcing, further years and policy welfare are excluded. Equivalent scalar-map scheduling theorems may exist outside inspected material; an antecedent 1999 management paper was available in abstract only, and an older working-paper antecedent has year-only date evidence.
title: Two-crossing reversal of two-year phosphorus loading in a bistable lake map
